import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 2.0,
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.alpha': 0.3,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'legend.framealpha': 0.8,
    'legend.edgecolor': 'none',
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))

p = np.linspace(1e-6, 1.0, 1000)

def pc(p, K):
    return p / (1 - (1 - p)**K)

colors = {'4': '#1F77B4', '8': '#D62728', '16': '#2CA02C'}
widths = {'4': 2, '8': 2.5, '16': 2}

for K_str, K_val in [('4', 4), ('8', 8), ('16', 16)]:
    y = pc(p, K_val)
    ax.plot(p, y, color=colors[K_str], linewidth=widths[K_str], label=f'$K={K_str}$')

# K→∞: y = p
ax.plot(p, p, color='#7F7F7F', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--', label=r'$K \to \infty$')

# 50% random chance line
ax.axhline(y=0.5, color='#999999', linewidth=1, linestyle=':', zorder=1)

ax.axvline(x=0.2, color='#AAAAAA', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', zorder=0)
ax.text(0.1, 0.05, 'typical agent\ntask range', fontsize=7, color='#888888',
        ha='center', va='bottom', style='italic')

# Operating point p=0.125, K=8
p_op = 0.125
pc_op = pc(p_op, 8)
ax.scatter([p_op], [pc_op], color='#D62728', s=100, zorder=5, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)

ax.annotate(
    f'$p=12.5\\%$, $K=8$\n$P_c = {pc_op:.1%}$'.replace('%', '\\%'),
    xy=(p_op, pc_op),
    xytext=(0.38, 0.28),
    fontsize=8,
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='#CCCCCC', lw=0.8),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#666666', lw=1.0,
                    connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.2'),
    zorder=6,
)

# Penalty reward measured point
ax.scatter([p_op], [0.52], color='#FF7F0E', s=70, marker='D', zorder=5,
           edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
ax.annotate(
    'penalty reward\n(measured)',
    xy=(p_op, 0.52),
    xytext=(0.38, 0.58),
    fontsize=7.5,

    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='#FFD0A0', lw=0.8),

)

ax.set_xlabel('Episode success rate $p$')
ax.set_ylabel('$P(\\mathrm{correct\\ sign} \\mid \\mathrm{update})$')
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(0, 1.1, 0.2))
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 1.1, 0.2))

ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8)

    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 2.0,
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.alpha': 0.3,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'legend.framealpha': 0.8,
    'legend.edgecolor': 'none',
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))

p = np.linspace(1e-6, 1.0, 1000)

def pc(p, K):
    return p / (1 - (1 - p)**K)

for K_val, color, lw in [(4, '#1F77B4', 2), (8, '#D62728', 2.5), (16, '#2CA02C', 2)]:
    ax.plot(p, pc(p, K_val), color=color, linewidth=lw, label=f'$K={K_val}$')

ax.plot(p, p, color='#7F7F7F', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--', label=r'$K \to \infty$')

# Random chance line
ax.axhline(y=0.5, color='#999999', linewidth=1, linestyle=':', zorder=1)
ax.text(0.72, 0.515, 'random chance', fontsize=6.5, color='#888888', va='bottom')

# Shaded region
ax.fill_between([0, 0.2], 0, 1, color='#CCCCCC', alpha=0.12, zorder=0)
ax.axvline(x=0.2, color='#AAAAAA', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', zorder=0)
ax.text(0.10, 0.92, 'typical agent\ntask range', fontsize=6.5, color='#888888',
        ha='center', va='top', style='italic')

# Operating point
p_op = 0.125
pc_op = pc(p_op, 8)
ax.scatter([p_op], [pc_op], color='#D62728', s=80, zorder=5, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)

ax.annotate(
    r'$p{=}12.5\%,\; K{=}8$' + '\n' + r'$P_c = 19.1\%$',
    xy=(p_op, pc_op),
    xytext=(0.32, 0.06),
    fontsize=7,
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='#CCCCCC', lw=0.7),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#666666', lw=0.8,
                    connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.2'),
    zorder=6,
)

# Penalty reward measured point
ax.scatter([p_op], [0.52], color='#FF7F0E', s=50, marker='D', zorder=5,
           edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.6)
ax.annotate(
    'penalty reward\n(measured)',
    xy=(p_op, 0.52),
    xytext=(0.24, 0.68),
    fontsize=6.5,
    color='#E07000',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='white', ec='#FFD0A0', lw=0.7),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#FF7F0E', lw=0.8,
                    connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.1'),
    zorder=6,
)

ax.set_xlabel('Episode success rate $p$')
ax.set_ylabel(r'$P(\mathrm{correct\ sign} \mid \mathrm{update})$')
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(0, 1.1, 0.2))
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 1.1, 0.2))

ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8)

out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_1/projects/cost-verify-agent-rl/docs/paper/fig_theory_curve.pdf'
fig.savefig(out)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved to {out}')
